name: Samelisant
summary: Samelisant is an experimental wakefulness-promoting agent acting as a selective histamine H3 receptor inverse agonist which is under development for the treatment of narcolepsy. It was also under development for the treatment of cognition disorders and Parkinson's disease, but no recent development has been reported for these indications.

pharmacology.text: Samelisant (INN; developmental code name SUVN-G3031) is an experimental wakefulness-promoting agent acting as a selective histamine H3 receptor inverse agonist which is under development for the treatment of narcolepsy.
pharmacology.kind: Histamine H3 receptor inverse agonist; Wakefulness-promoting agent

uses.text: Samelisant (INN; developmental code name SUVN-G3031) is an experimental wakefulness-promoting agent acting as a selective histamine H3 receptor inverse agonist which is under development for the treatment of narcolepsy. It was also under development for the treatment of cognition disorders and Parkinson's disease, but no recent development has been reported for these indications.

fact.en: Samelisant does the opposite of histamine at the H3 receptor, which raises histamine release in the brain and promotes wakefulness. Pitolisant, already approved for narcolepsy, works the same way.
fact.zh: Samelisant 在 H3 受體上的作用和組織胺相反，會提高腦中組織胺的釋放而促進清醒。已核准用於猝睡症的替洛利生也是同樣的機制。
fact.zhHans: Samelisant 在 H3 受体上的作用和组织胺相反，会提高脑中组织胺的释放而促进清醒。已核准用于猝睡症的替洛利生也是同样的机制。
